rubric_items.reason: All nine design components have at least one threat. The PII-bearing components (patientsRouter, PatientService, PatientRepo) each have several. The unchanged endpoints are covered through T-11 and T-12.
Most threats are specific to this change (medical history in list mapping, wildcard select, inference from the doctor). T-7 and T-10 are weaker, speculative threats.
Most mitigations are concrete new controls that can be tested. T-5 calls a design choice an existing control without citing it, and T-10 relies on an API validation assumption that has no basis.

Assumptions and unknowns are listed and the access-control gap is raised as Q-01. The T-10 assumption has no basis and no question. Q-01 defaults to staff-only access even though the deployment-shape section points to a Render deployment.
Clear, and ordered by risk with the highest first. The front matter and the body repeat each other heavily.
